Kuchup is now in your Cursor MCP config (`~/.cursor/mcp.json`) as a remote server at `https://mcp.kuchup.com/mcp`. I can’t finish OAuth from this chat — you have to connect in the UI.

1. Open **Cursor Settings → MCP**.
2. Find **kuchup** and click **Connect**.
3. Sign in with your kuchup.com panel username/password and approve access.
4. Start a **new** agent chat. This one was started without those tools, so they won’t show up here even after login.

If Connect doesn’t appear, reload the window (**Developer: Reload Window**) after saving the config. Don’t paste an API token into Cursor for this path — OAuth is the right auth.
